Delivers: The reports page downloads on-demand CSV with the 12 visible-by-default columns and bounded paging. ACs 1, 4; 3, 5 deferred per spec to acme/widgets#46; 2 deviates per spec: the table has 40 columns, so the export includes the 12 visible-by-default columns (Design clause 3); 4's observable half (export completes under 5s on production data) is checked after merge, not here.

Nits:
- The export pages results with its own loop instead of the shared paging helper, so a paging bug fixed once would need fixing twice. (src/api/export.ts:31, lib/page.ts)

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (test)

1. merge - squash the PR into its base branch [recommended]
2. show evidence - display the gate evidence, claim dispositions, and AC outcomes
3. stop - leave the PR as-is

Type a number. Not offered: fix (no helper facility is available).

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: The Delivers line names rows 1 and 4 as covered, row 2 as deviating per spec and rows 3 and 5 as deferred to acme/widgets#46, and with no blockers, a short nit and a one-line mergeable verdict the user can decide from the first screen and act on the numbered menu with merge recommended and nothing posted.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: The Delivers clause names the required dispositions and the numbered menu offers merge without blockers or posts, but the intervening nit section prevents briefing quality.
